text:
elaine (partnerships): Heads-up — preparing a lightweight observability guidance doc we can bundle with marketplace listings and partner onboarding. Aim: make tracing & sampling recommendations clear for GPU-backed inference and batch embedding pipelines. Need input from eng-ml + eng-sre + product.

samir (eng-ml): +1. Pain point: customers see huge OTLP cardinality from per-token spans. We should recommend server-side sampling + client prefix sampling. Link to notes: https://go/reports/obs-inference (internal).

maddy (eng-sre): Agree. Also add throttled agent configs for dd-trace and otel-collector. We have a draft config that reduces span rate by dropping per-token internal spans.

igor (product): What about dashboards? Marketing wants a 'trace health' tile for marketplace pages — simple SLA, P50/p95 latency, sampling ratio, and tracing error rate.

elaine (partnerships): Good. Let's capture: (1) recommended sampler configs, (2) collector deployment patterns (sidecar vs central), (3) dashboard templating (Datadog + Grafana), (4) one-pager for hardware partners (NVIDIA / AWS Inferentia) on metric tags to include.

samir (eng-ml): Proposed sampler snippet:
```
# otel-collector sampling processor
processors:
  probabilisticsampler:
    hash_seed: 1234
    sampling_percentage: 5
```
And recommend agent sampling at client for token spans: sample 0.5% of per-token spans, keep all request-level spans.

maddy (eng-sre): Datadog dashboard idea: use `redwood.inference.request_latency` with tag `model` and `instance_type`; add trace analytics query to show sampled trace rate. We'll create a dashboard JSON template.

igor (product): For partner collateral, include a short 'what to enable' checklist: enable metrics export, add latency and gpu_util tags, apply sampling at client, point to dashboard template, add contact for support.

elaine (partnerships): Who can own the marketplace bundle PR? @samir can you draft the sampling section? @maddy the dashboard template? I'll coordinate partner collateral and run review with legal for the NVIDIA co-branded playbook.

samir (eng-ml): I can draft. ETA EOD Wed.

maddy (eng-sre): I'll start the Datadog template; ping me for metric names. ETA Thu morning.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline started for obs-playbook branch (build 8723) :gear:

elaine (partnerships): Great — I'll post the draft to the partnerships drive and tag partners for feedback. If anyone has prior customer pain logs or examples of noisy token spans, drop them here or DM.

samir (eng-ml): I'll paste a short noisy-span example in the doc.

maddy (eng-sre): Also recommend adding a 'cost vs fidelity' appendix showing tokens-per-dollar impact of different sampling rates.

elaine (partnerships): Perfect, thanks team :party-parrot:
